name: plan
description: Create a concise plan for a bounded L1 or L2 change.
argument-hint: feature or issue context
---
# Plan

Read `AGENTS.md` and the source Issue. Select L1 or L2, state the smallest route, files/contracts, relevant tests, and any focused risk control. Write or update `docs/features/<id>/plan.md` only when the work needs durable documentation. Stop for missing scope or human decisions.
